skill.name: personwise-employee-onboarding
skill.description: Creates grounded employee onboarding courses from supplied handbooks, plans, and internal documents through the PersonWise CLI and hosted service.
skill.summary: Turn approved onboarding materials into a private, reviewable digital-human course with voice questions and optional assessments.
skill.author: personwiseai

security_audit.summary: All 142 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, defensive installer operations, fixed verified downloads, and signed descriptor data. Semantic review found high-risk native signature bypass and server-supplied update execution, plus document-upload and disclosure concerns.

remediation.issue: Native signature checks are disabled for macOS and Windows releases.
remediation.suggestion: Require verified Apple notarization and Authenticode identities before installation, while retaining pinned archive and executable hashes.

remediation.issue: Service responses can supply an update command for the agent to execute.
remediation.suggestion: Parse update actions as structured data and allow only fixed PersonWise update commands with validated paths and flags.

remediation.issue: Selected internal documents are uploaded without a separate external-transfer confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the destination and request explicit confirmation before uploading files that may contain internal or employee information.

remediation.issue: Normal installation instructions suppress security-relevant details.
remediation.suggestion: Present the download origin, installed path, signature status, and external service use before requesting installation approval.

semantic_findings.title: Native Signature Verification Disabled
semantic_findings.description: The installers accept releases marked deferred-founder-approved while native signature enforcement is disabled. Pinned hashes provide integrity but not independent publisher authentication.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both installers contain constant conditions that bypass native signature enforcement for the distributed macOS and Windows binaries.

semantic_findings.title: Server-Supplied Update Command Execution
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs the agent to run an update action returned by the service without validating its command shape against a local allowlist.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly require running the exact returned action after approval, but they do not require local parsing or command allowlisting.

semantic_findings.title: Implicit External Upload of Internal Documents
semantic_findings.description: The skill treats user-selected onboarding documents as authorized for upload to PersonWise. These files can contain confidential policy and employee information.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly uploads selected local paths and states that these courses normally contain internal information.

semantic_findings.title: Reduced Installation Transparency
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent not to explain hashes, signing, reputation, credential storage, descriptors, or contracts during the normal installer path.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction explicitly suppresses security-relevant context while asking the host to obtain permission for binary installation.

high_findings.title: Native Signature Verification Disabled
high_findings.description: The installers accept releases marked deferred-founder-approved while native signature enforcement is disabled. Pinned hashes provide integrity but not independent publisher authentication.
high_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both installers contain constant conditions that bypass native signature enforcement for the distributed macOS and Windows binaries.

high_findings.title: Server-Supplied Update Command Execution
high_findings.description: The skill directs the agent to run an update action returned by the service without validating its command shape against a local allowlist.
high_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly require running the exact returned action after approval, but they do not require local parsing or command allowlisting.

content.value_statement: New hires need consistent guidance grounded in current internal materials. This skill creates a private, reviewable PersonWise course from approved onboarding sources.
actual_capabilities: Builds an onboarding course blueprint from supplied handbooks, plans, and internal documents.
Uses PersonWise readiness checks to fit the course within current slide and credit limits.
Uploads user-selected sources and tracks processing until each source is ready.
Reviews outlines, scripts, images, and course state at durable workflow checkpoints.
Publishes private or link-access courses when the user requests that access mode.
limitations: Requires the PersonWise CLI, a PersonWise account, browser OAuth, and available course credits.
Sends approved source documents to the PersonWise hosted service for processing.
Cannot verify policies, dates, people, or benefits that supplied materials do not support.
Does not replace HR, legal, compensation, or benefits professionals for individual cases.

use_cases.title: Create a Company Welcome Course
use_cases.description: Convert a handbook and first-week plan into a grounded course for incoming employees.

use_cases.title: Build a Role Ramp Program
use_cases.description: Turn team processes, tools, and milestones into structured training for a specific role.

use_cases.title: Standardize Distributed Onboarding
use_cases.description: Deliver consistent onboarding content with voice questions for employees across locations and schedules.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Onboarding Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a private employee onboarding course from the attached handbook. Focus on company purpose, first-week tasks, working norms, and support contacts.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has one approved handbook and needs a concise course.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Role Ramp Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a course for new [role] employees using these approved materials. Include first-month milestones, tools, team rituals, and escalation contacts.
prompt_templates.scenario: A manager needs role-specific training from several internal sources.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Materials-Only Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [page count]-page onboarding course using only the supplied documents. Mark unsupported or time-sensitive statements for HR confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: A regulated team requires strict grounding and a fixed course size.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and Refine an Existing Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume project [project ID], inspect current run state, and refine unsupported or inconsistent content. Preserve slide order and keep access private.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs checkpoint-aware recovery and bounded edits.

output_examples.input: Create a five-page private onboarding course from our handbook and first-week checklist.
output: Teaching arc: welcome, first week, working norms, role ramp, and support contacts.
Grounding: handbook and checklist only, with time-sensitive items marked for HR confirmation.

output_examples.input: Our requested course exceeds the account slide limit. Build the strongest available version.
output_examples.output: The account supports eight slides. The course was recomposed into eight complete sections instead of truncating the original outline.

output_examples.input: Publish the approved onboarding course for employees with the link.
output_examples.output: Link access was enabled after confirming the current course state. The final response identifies the playable share link and verified access mode.

best_practices: Provide current, approved source materials and identify the intended learner role.
Keep sensitive courses private unless broader access is explicitly required.
Review policy, benefits, dates, names, and escalation contacts before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent missing policies, benefits, dates, or organizational details.
Do not upload discovered local files without reviewing their contents and approving the transfer.
Do not describe a private editor link as a public share link.

faq.question: What materials can I provide?
faq.answer: You can provide approved handbooks, onboarding plans, role guides, process documents, org diagrams, and selected images.

faq.question: Does the skill use only my documents?
faq.answer: It can use a strict materials-only mode or an open mode with supplied documents as anchors.

faq.question: Where are source documents processed?
faq.answer: Selected documents are uploaded to the PersonWise hosted service through its CLI for course processing.

faq.question: Can the course remain private?
faq.answer: Yes. Private access is the default unless you request link access, publication, or Topics submission.

faq.question: Does this replace HR guidance?
faq.answer: No. Individual labor, compensation, benefits, and legal questions should go to qualified HR or legal professionals.

faq.question: What happens when the account has limits?
faq.answer: The skill checks live readiness and recomposes the course within available credits and slide limits.
